description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio (x-axis, labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)", ranging from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20) and two metrics: perplexity (left y-axis, labeled "Perplexity", ranging from 4.2 to 4.7) and GPU memory ratio (right y-axis, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)", ranging from 40% to 100% with tick marks at intervals of 10). The plot contains four lines: an orange line with circle markers representing "Perplexity", which starts at approximately 4.6 and generally trends downward to around 4.3 before rising slightly to about 4.4; a blue line with circle markers representing "GPU Mem. Ratio", which starts at approximately 42% and increases steeply to nearly 100% as the recent sequence ratio approaches 100; a dashed red line representing "Full Cache PPL" at a constant value of approximately 4.4; and a dashed blue line representing "Full Cache GPU Mem." at a constant value of 100%.
